runs.design: the verification block, run before anything is measured: seven bank digests against the phase-2 commitment, the sealed adversary half against SEAL.json, the freeze artifact's R1/R2a/R3 round trips, the seed registry, and the engine self-audit

runs.command: engine/gate_v07.sh --spec=SPEC --id=NAME  (pathology --games=400 --rotations=2 --seed=31 --threads=13, plus v7side on both TRAINING banks with S6 at --threads=1 --freshagents)

the human-readable gate digest with each threshold's provenance

headline strength against the frontier; paired duplicate, both primary banks 7090001 and 7090002; 12,000 deals a bank against v06 / F-cheap / the phase-2 composite, 3,000 against F-mid, 6,000 against v05

the shared panel: four arms (FROZEN, INCUMBENT, F-cheap, the phase-2 composite) against 31 panel members (14 sealed adversaries, 13 scripted archetypes, 4 frontier points) on both primary banks; near 6,000 deals a bank, far 1,500, expensive 1,200
eight independent fresh adversary searches against the frozen configuration, sharded across the two sealed fitting banks; 8 x 12 x 120 deals x 2 rotations = 23,040 games each
each fitted adversary re-measured against the frozen configuration on the two EVALUATION banks, disjoint from the banks it was fitted on; 24,000 games an arm
the attribution lattice: six add-one-in cells from v06, five leave-one-out cells from FROZEN, and the FROZEN reference the drops are taken from; banks 7090003 and 7090001
the partner-regime table: three arms at all eight partner settings against v05, and two arms at four settings against v06; 24,000 games a cell

runs.command: fish7 match --a=run_i --partners=run_j --b=v05 ... ; and each unordered pair head to head

the rule-dialect table, unbundled: both arms play the same dialect, eight rows

planted-edge recovery (B9.2), the sub-floor rung that must NOT be recovered (B9.3), and the identity control (B9.4)
the three calibrated side-channel positive controls (B9.5)
the S6 residual on holdout material, in both conditions: one thread alone, and one thread with agents rebuilt per deal
